title: XXI: The New England Holiday

teacherSummary.text: Election Day brings a festive crowd: Native people, sailors and townsfolk. Hester's face is calm, as if this were the last day of her ordeal. The ship's captain tells her that Chillingworth has booked passage on the same ship. Chillingworth smiles at her across the square.
